a.name: Sunk slip
a.description: One soft steel slip pressed into the page, set left: the display line, what a subscriber gets, then the field and button stacked in it.
a.differs_from: Everything in one sunk slip set left in the column, no photo; London's pick is a raised card with a photo at its left, and C is a split steel band.

b.name: Postmarked note
b.description: A short signed note between rules, with Vennie as a round postmark photo in a dashed ring at the right.
b.differs_from: A signed note framed by rules with a round postmark photo at the right; London's pick is a raised card with a square photo at the left.

c.name: Split steel band
c.description: A compact steel band: envelope, line and sentence left-set on the left, the joined field and brass submit on the right.
c.differs_from: Refresh delta, layout: London's centred one-column band becomes a split band from 1024px, copy left and form right. Differs from London's pick on all four axes.
